## Checklist

- [ ] **It runs:** every scenario you touched builds and runs, full and with `--quick`, and its checks pass (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] **The spec:** the change follows [SCENARIOS.md](SCENARIOS.md), or changes it, with its version moved.
- [ ] **Twin repo:** the same change is needed in the Rust twin, `strata-stress-rust`, or it isn't. Say which. A change to `SCENARIOS.md` always is.
- [ ] **Real numbers:** any figure in a README or `RESULTS.md` comes from a real run, with its machine, versions and date.
- [ ] **Signed off:** every commit has a `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`, see the DCO in CONTRIBUTING.md).
